title: AAE Audit Record (one JSONL line)
description: Audit contract. Each record is one line of JSON. Every record MUST carry input parameters, the resulting state summary, and the delta attribution defined by the normative algorithm. An `llm_call` record MUST additionally carry the fields in $defs.llmCallExtra.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number within the session.

engine.description: Engine version tag; the main engine reports "SPL-V8.0".

snapshot.description: State summary (key set defined by the specification).

deltaMap.description: Per-key attribution of one state transition. Keys are scalar names or dotted nested paths (e.g. "fluid.喜悦"). Entries whose before and after are equal MUST be omitted.

deltaEntry.description: A numeric entry carries {before, after, delta} with delta = round(after - before, 6). A non-numeric entry carries only {before, after} and MUST NOT carry a delta key. Booleans MUST NOT be treated as numeric and MUST NOT be given a fabricated difference.

llmCallExtra.description: Additional fields required on an `llm_call` record.

tokenUsage.description: Token usage. null when unavailable; when non-null it MUST contain the three integer fields below.
